name: Does God Forgive Gays
overview: Scripture clearly defines homosexual behavior as sinful, describing it as an abomination in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13. Yet, the Gospel offers hope through God's love and the sacrifice of Jesus Christ, who came so that whoever believes in Him may have everlasting life (John 3:16). While no one is righteous on their own (Romans 3:10), forgiveness and redemption are available to all who repent and trust in Christ, emphasizing the central commandment to love God and others (Mark 12:28).
